headline: Akshay Poddar files substantial acquisition disclosure in Texmaco Infrastructure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Akshay Poddar has triggered a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial share acquisition in Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings Limited, a Mumbai-based rail and infrastructure engineering company.
detail: Akshay Poddar has formally notified the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) of a substantial acquisition triggering disclosure requirements under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing does not disclose the acquisition price, quantum of shares acquired, or the final consideration; Texmaco Infrastructure is a publicly listed company in the rail and infrastructure engineering sector. The disclosure mechanism is mandatory within 2 trading days of crossing the threshold or entering into a binding agreement.

triggers.note: Disclosure trigger upon crossing 5% threshold or entry into binding agreement; 2-day filing window starts; applies to all acquirers in Indian listed companies.
Listed entity (Texmaco) must simultaneously make public disclosure and confirm to exchange; exchange filing precedent to or concurrent with market disclosure.
Acquirer must assess combined turnover/asset thresholds; if crossed, CCI mandatory notification required within 30 days of 'combination' becoming 'complete'.
